# Marketplace Onboarding

Transforms a built SaaS platform into a publishable marketplace offer.

## Scope

- Partner Center readiness and role assignments.
- Offer metadata, plans, pricing, and legal artifacts.
- Technical validation and certification prep.
- Private preview and go-live motion.

## Deliverables

- End-to-end onboarding checklist.
- Submission-quality artifact inventory.
- Launch gate report with blocking/non-blocking findings.
